papers.title_en: WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization
papers.authors: Linxi Xie, Chonghua Liao, Mengxuan Wu, Guandao Yang, Zhangyang Wang, Kai Wang
papers.evidence: 根据用户持续变化的交互历史与偏好个性化语言模型助手
papers.tldr: 用户偏好会随时间变化，但相关信号往往淹没在嘈杂的交互历史中，反复处理历史或逐用户微调又会带来额外开销。WASP 用共享超网络从原始交互中提取细粒度偏好，每次仅根据新增交互更新紧凑的用户状态，并通过一次前向计算生成个性化 LoRA 适配器。个性化基准和按时间排序的交互流实验表明，该方法在固定计算与存储预算下仍能长期维持较高的个性化质量。单次更新成本不随历史长度增长，有利于在设备端持续适配并将敏感交互留在本地。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. Experiments on personalization benchmarks and chronological interaction streams show that WASP sustains high-quality personalization over long horizons under fixed compute and storage budgets. Together, these results support efficient streaming personalization and facilitate privacy-preserving on-device deployment.

papers.title_en: Evaluating Persona Consistency in LLM User Simulators Without External Reference Annotations
papers.authors: Anping Zhang, Yang Tan, Yipeng Liu, Clive Bai, Blaze Chen, Yang Li
papers.evidence: 评估语言模型智能体模拟人物特质与行为的一致性。
papers.tldr: 从简短、任务导向的对话构建用户角色时，通常缺少外部人格标注，难以判断模拟行为是否一致。论文让同一角色先做量表自评，再完成情境选择和开放作答，用自评与两类行为画像在六个特质维度上的相关性衡量一致性。在三套数据上，补充了人物画像的表示均优于仅用原始对话的基线，并在有社区标注的数据上复现了按外部标注评估所得的排序。该方法无需外部标注即可比较角色构建策略，但不能验证模拟是否忠实于真实用户。
papers.abstract_en: Standard evaluations assess LLM-simulated personas against an external ground truth, such as community trait annotations, but that reference is unavailable when the persona is inferred only from a short, task-oriented chat. We ask how persona consistency can be evaluated without such a reference, and propose a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic: the persona describes itself once and acts twice. A Likert self-report supplies a soft internal anchor; two behavioral profiles come from constrained scenario choices scored without a judge and from open-ended responses judged by an LLM. Consistency is the correlation between the self-report and each behavioral profile, in a shared six-facet BFI-2 space. The framework compares persona-construction strategies by assessing how consistently their elicited responses reflect their self-reported traits. Across ordinary-user chats (WildChat and LMSYS) and well-documented personas with community annotations (the Personality Database, PDB), profile-enriched representations agree with the anchor more closely than a raw-dialogue baseline. On PDB, this self-anchored ordering reproduces the community-annotation ordering. The pattern is stable across answering and judge models.

papers.title_en: Exploring Multi-Player Social Games as Verifiable Training Grounds for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Keyu He, Michael Li, Jiarui Liu, Mingqian Zheng, Koichi Onoue, Tongshuang Wu, Maarten Sap
papers.evidence: 利用强化学习训练语言模型在多人社交游戏中的合作与推理能力
papers.tldr: 训练大模型的社交能力常依赖模型裁判，但裁判成本高、评分有噪声，也容易被钻空子。研究让 Qwen3 在三款需要开放交流、团队协作和隐藏角色推断的多人游戏中接受监督微调，再以规则判定的胜负作为可验证奖励进行强化学习。对阵 Gemma-3-27B 时，Qwen3-4B 在训练游戏的胜率从33%升至81%，在三款未见游戏中从39%升至54%。结果表明，客观胜负可用于训练社交策略，且部分收益能迁移到新游戏。
papers.abstract_en: The training of socially intelligent language models often relies on large language model (LLM) judges, which are expensive, noisy, and vulnerable to reward hacking. Multi-player social games offer a natural alternative: they require open-ended communication to coordinate with teammates and infer hidden roles, while their rules provide an objective outcome which can serve as a verifiable reward for training. Using three social games, we explore how much social intelligence Qwen3 models can acquire through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Results show that against a much stronger Gemma-3-27B model, SFT and RLVR raise the win rate of Qwen3-4B from 33% to 81% on the three trained games, and from 39% to 54% on three additional held-out games. In contrast, in-context strategies such as prompting improve the win rate of Qwen3-4B by only about 6 pp across the same games we train and evaluate on. Furthermore, we show that the gains from SFT and RLVR hold across the model sizes 1.7B, 4B, and 32B. Qualitative analyses of agent behavior show signs of stronger social intelligence; for example, trained agents tend to share information more openly, check each other's claims against public evidence, and coordinate their votes. More broadly, our results demonstrate that training LLMs on verifiable outcomes in social games can cultivate generalizable social behaviors, which offers a scalable path for building socially intelligent agents.

papers.title_en: Joint Detection of Constructive Speech, Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations
papers.authors: Ida Dencker, Simon Karg, Kenneth Enevoldsen
papers.evidence: 训练多语言大模型检测线上对话中的建设性言论、仇恨言论与认同关系。
papers.tldr: 网络仇恨言论可能使用户退出讨论，而在部分社交平台减少内容审核的背景下，建设性言论成为应对仇恨的一种途径。研究收集并标注英语和丹麦语社媒评论，微调多种多语言模型，联合识别仇恨语气、建设性语气及对上级评论的赞同情况。E5-large在加入和不加入对话上下文时均表现最佳，平均F1分别为82%和81.6%。结果表明，多语言模型有望用于规模化监测两类言论，帮助了解其出现频率及在对话中的变化。
papers.abstract_en: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.

papers.title_en: Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory
papers.authors: Shuguang Chen, Salman Paracha
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型助手设计跨交互记忆，关注记忆对未来响应的效用。
papers.tldr: 现有大模型智能体记忆多按对历史对话的忠实度评估，但准确复述过去不等于能改善未来回答。Leto 用索引保留回查原始细节的入口，在请求到来时通过记忆回放补充未明说的上下文，再用回答结果调整后续选取。相比最强对照方法，PrefEval 准确率高出 16.3 个百分点；长程任务的优势随任务链加深而扩大，长上下文理解则以更少词元达到与原始历史检索相当的表现。这项工作把记忆评估的重点从记录是否忠实转向回答是否受益。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.

papers.title_en: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
papers.authors: Yige Luo, Shining Zhang, Jikun Liu, Hongjiao Qiang, Ran Guan
papers.evidence: 用户主动引导个性化信息流，系统适应需求变化并增强用户控制
papers.tldr: 传统推荐流难以跟上用户不断变化的需求，论文将用户可主动调整推荐方向的信息发现形式化为新任务。Agentic Waterfall 用语言模型控制器从显式请求和浏览行为更新持久用户状态，并协调内容检索与排序。该框架在五个公开基准上保持竞争力，在新数据集的两项评估中均优于最强基线，相对提升最高为16.1%。配套数据集和回放协议让不同系统能在相同交互历史下比较其满足当前目标与约束的能力。
papers.abstract_en: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.

papers.title_en: Supporting Without Taking Over: AI Support in Gratitude Writing
papers.authors: Thu Bui, Shashi Salavath, Hillary Merzdorf, Louis Tay, Sooyeon Jeong
papers.evidence: 研究面向福祉干预的AI交互设计，比较提问引导与共同写作。
papers.tldr: 感恩写作有助于提升心理福祉，但独立练习缺少引导，人工智能直接代拟文字又可能削弱写作者的掌控感。研究招募401人，交叉比较感恩反思与感恩信，以及停笔后提出反思问题的支架式辅助与提供行内建议的共写辅助。参与者写作后福祉有所提升；共写更易用却可能打断思路，建议采纳越多与自主感越弱相关，而支架更能保留作品归属感，却容易被忽略。研究表明，设计情感写作工具时，不仅要考虑易用性，也要让写作者保有对表达的掌控。
papers.abstract_en: Gratitude writing can support well-being, but independent practice may lack guidance. Generative AI could help while shaping reflection, agency, and ownership. We investigated how gratitude-writing format and AI-assistance mode influence well-being and writing experiences. In a 2x2 between-subjects study (N=401), participants completed a gratitude reflection or a gratitude letter using two AI-assistance modes: scaffolding, which provided reflective questions after inactivity, or co-writing, which offered inline text suggestions. Participants' well-being improved after using our AI-assisted gratitude-writing system, consistent with the activity's intended benefits. However, participants' experiences revealed a trade-off between the AI-support types: co-writing received higher usability ratings, yet its immediacy could disrupt writing, and greater suggestion acceptance was associated with weaker perceived agency. Scaffolding supported stronger perceived human ownership but was sometimes overlooked. These findings extend human-AI writing research beyond productivity and text quality by showing how AI involvement shapes psychological outcomes and the experience of self-guided, emotionally meaningful writing.

papers.title_en: TouchBench: Can Vision-Language Models Feel Invisible Physical Properties?
papers.authors: Ziyao Zeng, Ziyi Kou, Chuan Qin, Mia Huang, Roger Boldu, Zhiwen Fan, Daniel Rakita, Eric Whitmire, Li Guan
papers.evidence: 评测触觉感知作为具身交互中的触摸模态。
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言模型多在可凭图像作答的任务上评估，但不透明瓶中的液量、物体受压后的形变等操控相关属性往往要靠触觉判断。TouchBench 将可见与视觉隐藏的属性分开评测，并同步采集第一视角视频与全手触觉；TaP 则把触觉信号概括为文本统计量。纯视觉模型在隐藏属性的比较题上接近随机，引入触觉文本后，零样本准确率由49.8%升至62.9%，留一用户微调后达73.1%。结果表明，无需学习专用触觉编码器，文本也能为模型提供有效的触觉线索。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for embodied perception and reasoning, yet their physical understanding is largely evaluated on questions answerable from images. Many properties critical to manipulation, such as an opaque bottle's fill level or an object's compliance, may only be revealed through touch. We introduce TouchBench, an egocentric vision-language-tactile benchmark that distinguishes visually answerable questions (Tier A) from those involving properties hidden from the camera (Tier B). It pairs head-mounted video with synchronized 137-channel whole-hand tactile sensing, comprising 900 clips from five participants across 11 tasks, with 900 absolute and 4,102 relative questions. Four state-of-the-art VLMs average 66.4% accuracy on Tier A relative questions but only 49.8% on Tier B, near chance (50%). To bridge this gap, we propose Tactile-as-Prompt (TaP), which presents 34 interpretable tactile statistics as text, enabling VLMs to reason with touch without a learned tactile encoder. TaP raises zero-shot Tier B relative accuracy to 62.9% and reaches 73.1% after leave-one-user-out fine-tuning, outperforming video alone (67.4%) and a learned tactile-token encoder (67.3%). The gains extend to unseen objects and users. On a separate 20-hour in-the-wild corpus, tactile text improves fine-tuned contact-question accuracy from 67.1% to 75.5%. These results highlight the limits of vision-only physical reasoning and establish language as an effective interface for tactile perception.

papers.title_en: Explainable Emotion and Mental Health Reasoning in Large Language Models Using Theories of Emotion
papers.authors: Tadesse Destaw Bela, Iqra Ameer, Helena Gómez Adorno, Alexander Gelbukh, Eusebio Ricardez Vázquez, Olga Kolesnikova, Grigori Sidorov, Seid Muhie Yimam
papers.evidence: 以情绪理论支撑可解释推理，并评估其心理健康相关语言任务
papers.tldr: 传统文本情绪识别多直接预测预设标签，却较少解释个体为何在特定情境中产生某种情绪。本文提出心理学引导的思维链提示（PsyCoT），依据沙赫特–辛格双因素理论与认知评价理论，引导模型结合情境线索解释情绪判断。研究在十一种语言中评估五个大语言模型，覆盖情绪识别、情绪强度、压力和抑郁严重程度四类任务；相比标准思维链，F1提升幅度为0.5%至28.1%。这一方法在改善预测表现的同时，也让模型给出更有理论依据的判断解释。
papers.abstract_en: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a wide range of applications. However, their ability to simulate human-like behavior and reasoning remains unclear. While emotion detection is a better-established Natural Language Processing (NLP) task, existing approaches primarily focus on directly classifying text into predefined emotion classes, often overlooking the appraisal process that explains why an individual experiences a particular emotion in a given situation. In this work, we propose Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought (PsyCoT) reasoning, a theory-driven prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion. We propose and evaluate PsyCoT for subjective NLP tasks, including emotion analysis, emotion intensity prediction, stress analysis, and depression severity identification. Our evaluation covers four levels of classification complexity: binary, multiclass, multi-label, and ordinal scaling, spanning 11 languages. We assess the performance of five state-of-the-art LLMs across these selected subjective NLP tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that PsyCoT prompt variants improve the standard chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting across the evaluated tasks. Across all evaluated tasks, PsyCoT yields F1 score gains ranging from 0.5% to 28.1%, depending on the model, task, and language configuration.

papers.title_en: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Xiaokang Liu, Ke Sun, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 系统比较机器人使用接口对智能体交互和任务成功率的影响。
papers.tldr: 基础模型虽能推理复杂的物理任务，却未必能让机器人可靠执行；动作如何表达、何时反馈，都是关键。论文用覆盖五类场景的三十项操控任务，在共享感知与控制条件下比较十三种接口。仿真中，仅更换接口就使前沿智能体的成功率从45%升至81%，微调后的40亿参数模型从13%升至47%。好的接口应减少不必要的决策、保留关键反馈，并在任务层面核验结果，因为智能体常在失败可见时仍宣告成功。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.

papers.title_en: Beyond "AI Can Make Mistakes": How Risk Communication Shapes Trust and Decision Confidence for LLMs in Health Information Seeking
papers.authors: Jiawei Zhou, Mengting Tu, Shravika Mittal, Sowmya Krishna, Q. Vera Liao, Munmun De Choudhury
papers.evidence: 预注册用户实验检验LLM风险披露如何影响信任与依赖决策。
papers.tldr: 人们越来越常用大语言模型查询健康信息，但一句通用的错误提示能否帮助用户判断何时该依赖模型，仍不清楚。研究通过一项五百人参与的预注册实验，对比通用免责声明与在场景和机制解释上有所不同的结构化风险提示。结构化提示显著降低信任，针对健康场景的提示效果更强，但总体上未提高用户判断何时该依赖模型的信心。提示效果还因任务和用户的人工智能知识而异，说明降低信任不等于改善依赖判断。
papers.abstract_en: Adoption of LLMs for health information has outpaced public understanding, but whether risk communication can work as a corrective remains unknown. In a preregistered experiment (N=500), we compared a standard disclaimer against structured risk communication varying in contextual relevance and mechanistic explanation. Without intervention, users understanding LLMs less reported higher trust and confidence in deciding when to rely. Structured risk communication significantly reduced trust, more so with health-specific framing, but did not improve confidence in reliance decision. Risk disclosure was associated with higher decision confidence among those with stronger AI knowledge, but lower confidence among those less preferring analytical thinking. Effects were also task-dependent: disclosure shifted preferences for medical queries and impairment assistance, while LLMs remained preferred for emotional companionship regardless of exposure. These findings demonstrate that risk communication can narrow trust gaps across AI-literacy levels, but turning disclosure into judgment requires adapting to usage context and users' prior knowledge.

papers.title_en: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
papers.authors: Catarina Botelho, António Farinhas, John Mendonça, Areti Vassilopoulos, Inês Gonçalves, Maya D'Eon, Hugo Pitorro, Laura Cabello, Carrie Spadine, Nuno M. Guerreiro, Ricardo Rei
papers.evidence: 为心理健康支持场景开发临床专家参与的语言模型伤害评估方法。
papers.tldr: 现有心理健康对话护栏多按有害主题打标签，难以区分既往经历与迫在眉睫的风险。论文提出经临床专家验证的三维框架，标注伤害类型、涉及对象与发生时间，将风险描述和干预决策分离，并以短推理训练 MindGuard2。公开基准很少覆盖指向用户本人的伤害，而这类伤害在真实对话中占近半；新模型的平衡准确率与更大的 GLM-5.3 相当，中位延迟约为其十分之一。该框架让临床干预规则可独立更新和审计，模型也能在高召回下保持低误报。
papers.abstract_en: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. We introduce a clinically grounded taxonomy that characterizes harm along three dimensions: what the harm is, who is involved, and when it occurs. It further separates harm characterization from intervention decisions, thus enabling safety policies to be specified outside the model weights through explicit, clinician-curated instructions that can be updated and audited. We validate the taxonomy with expert clinicians and validate a panel of LLM judges to scale annotation. Relabeling public benchmarks in this taxonomy shows that they rarely contain harm directed at the user, which accounts for nearly half of the harm in real conversations. We then train MindGuard2, a 35B-A3B reasoning-based guard model using supervised fine-tuning on short reasoning traces followed by reinforcement learning with a reasoning-length penalty, to minimize inference overhead while preserving the benefits of reasoning. On two public benchmarks and real-world conversations, MindGuard2 achieves balanced accuracy comparable to the substantially larger GLM-5.3 at approximately 10x lower median latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Furthermore, it achieves low false-positive rates at high recall, helping balance the need to detect unsafe situations against the risk of unnecessary interventions that may disrupt support and undermine user trust. We release a safety guardrail model with SOTA performance trained on synthetic data, together with synthetic conversations and annotations of public benchmarks in our taxonomy.

papers.title_en: Evaluating Strategies for Multimodal Bidirectional Interactions between Pedestrians and AVs
papers.authors: André Clérigo, Maximilian Schrapel, Pedro Rito, Susana Sargento, Alexey Vinel
papers.evidence: 评估行人与自动驾驶车辆间的AR、语音及手势交互
papers.tldr: 缺少驾驶员眼神和手势等线索时，行人难以判断自动驾驶车辆是否注意到自己、是否理解自己的请求。研究结合文献综述、124人问卷和原型实验，评估行人用语音与手势表达意图、车辆用增强现实反馈的双向交互。参与者偏好明确呈现车辆动向或警告的提示、高层次语音指令和常见手势；本地处理更快，基础设施辅助识别更准。原型展示了从意图表达、识别到车辆决策与反馈的闭环，最终决策仍由车辆作出。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) share spaces with Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs) in encounters where driver cues are absent. This can leave people uncertain whether the vehicle has noticed them and understood their request. Existing research has studied how AVs communicate with pedestrians through external human-machine interfaces. This work investigates bidirectional multimodal VRU-AV interactions combining Augmented Reality (AR), speech, and gestures. The study follows four stages: literature synthesis of interactions, a survey with 124 participants, interaction loop implementation, and feasibility evaluation. Participants preferred AR cues that made vehicle motion or warnings explicit, high-level voice commands, and conventional gestures. Prototype measurements revealed a trade-off between faster local processing and more accurate infrastructure-assisted processing. The demonstration shows bidirectional interaction using AR wearables and vehicular communications, while leaving decision-making to the AV. Together, the results support treating AV-VRU interaction as a closed loop of intent expression, recognition, vehicle decision, and feedback.

papers.title_en: FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers
papers.authors: Zirui Li, Yujie Yan, Jingxuan Qian, Yangang Ren, Haizhou Yin, Haoran Xu, Chen Lv
papers.evidence: 人类接管恢复为视觉语言动作策略提供纠正监督
papers.tldr: 人工接管能为视觉—语言—动作策略提供纠错示范，但必须区分接管数据与继续训练各自的作用。FailPoint-X用同一策略检查点采集629次自然失败并初始化后训练，从标注区间内采样接管起点，再以等量策略更新和统一的留出失败状态比较方法。在240个低至中难度失败上，行为克隆比仅用原有示范续训多恢复29.4个百分点，价值学习未显示额外收益。标准起点的探索性测试则显示，克隆使成功率下降30个百分点，提示恢复和常规表现需同时评估。
papers.abstract_en: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.

papers.title_en: Reliable User Simulation in Complex Multi-Step Workflows
papers.authors: Pusala Pavan Teja, Jayasimha Talur, Saab Mansour, Marcello Federico
papers.evidence: 评测用于对话助手评估的用户模拟器保真度
papers.tldr: 大语言模型用户模拟器在多步对话中容易偏离指定目标或漏试备选项，导致评测把模拟器的错误归咎于助手。论文用分层任务网络构建了包含顺序任务、回退逻辑和跨任务依赖的五百个工作流，并提出通过推理与跨轮状态追踪维持目标的提示策略。实验发现，工作流越复杂，模拟保真度下降越明显，且多数失败源于目标漂移。该策略使中大型模型的目标成功率提升超过十二个百分点，并降低了评测对助手回复风格的敏感性。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate conversational assistants. Yet, these simulators can drift from their assigned goals or fail to exhaustively explore all specified options, causing evaluation errors incorrectly attributed to the assistant. Prior work has examined goal alignment in single-task settings, but many practical scenarios require simulators to execute multi-step workflows with sequential tasks, fallback logic, and cross-task dependencies, where simulator fidelity has not been measured. To close this gap, we introduce a benchmark of 500 workflows represented using the Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) abstraction. Our experiments reveal that the simulator's fidelity degrades sharply with workflow complexity, and that goal drift accounts for the majority of failures. Fidelity also depends on the assistant's response style, with the same simulator scoring substantially better or worse across styles. To address this, we propose ReUST (Reasoning + User State Tracking), a simple prompting strategy to maintain state information across dialogue turns. ReUST improves goal success rate by more than 12 points for mid-sized and large models, and reduces simulator sensitivity to the assistant's response style.

papers.title_en: Testing for Coordination Failures in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Dennis Gross, Jørn Eirik Betten, Helge Spieker
papers.evidence: 提出合作式多智能体强化学习策略的安全测试方法。
papers.tldr: 并行合作多智能体强化学习以共享奖励为目标，但奖励未必涵盖所有安全要求，已有测试方法也较少针对智能体自身的协调失误。论文提出 DisQ，在不执行系统的情况下比较各智能体对同一状态下可达回报的估计，仅执行差异超过校准阈值的候选测试。四个基准环境的实验表明，多数配置下该方法比随机测试和基于遗传算法的搜索更擅长检出失败。回报估计的分歧为筛选可能暴露协调失误的状态提供了可解释的依据。
papers.abstract_en: Deep parallel cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL)} trains multiple agents that all act at every time step to optimize a common objective. Like single-agent RL, CMARL can produce unsafe behaviors that violate implicit safety requirements not captured by the reward, and these behaviors are hard to explain. However, testing CMARL policies for safety has received less attention than the safety testing of single-agent RL policies. In this paper, we propose DisQ, a test case selection method that identifies failure-revealing states in value-based CMARL by exploiting a signal specific to trained Q-learning agents. The signal is the Q-value gap, an explainable metric that flags a state when the agents' estimates of the achievable return diverge by more than a calibrated threshold. DisQ selects such states for execution and skips those without a gap. Our experiments in four CMARL benchmark environments show that, in most of the evaluated configurations, DisQ improves failure detection over single-agent RL testing methods applied to CMARL, namely random testing and search-based testing with genetic algorithms. Our main contributions are the Q-value gap, an indicator of potential miscoordination computable from a single state without executing the system, and DisQ, a test case selection method that adapts existing single-agent testing methods to CMARL.

papers.title_en: mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments
papers.authors: Yi-Fei Cao, Tianxin Huang, Hanbo Xie, Jian-Qiao Zhu
papers.evidence: 通过交互式心理环境评估大语言模型智能体的类人行为。
papers.tldr: 同一大语言模型的行为会随智能体框架和推理预算而变，而静态文本复现无法检验智能体如何根据自身行动带来的反馈调整决策。研究将心理学任务改造成交互环境，并用从人类行为中学习的策略模型评估智能体的行为轨迹。轨迹与人类行为的相容性随任务和智能体配置而变，记忆带来的评分提升主要源于选择更可预测，而非行为更像人类。这表明评估不能只看基础模型，还应纳入智能体配置，并区分可预测性与类人性。
papers.abstract_en: A Large Language Model (LLM), its harness, and the test-time compute budget jointly determine its behavior. Consequently, the same underlying model, embedded in different agentic workflows or allocated different amounts of test-time compute, can exhibit markedly different performance. Psychologists face an analogous challenge when evaluating human performance: the same person may behave differently under different incentives and levels of deliberation. Psychological tasks therefore provide an ideal testbed for studying such behavioral variation. However, when adapted to LLMs, these tasks are typically text-transcribed, replaying fixed, language-rendered experiments as static prompts. This format is ill-suited to agent evaluation, where actions can alter future observations and task states. Conversely, although dynamic environments are prevalent in the evaluation of LLM agents, they rarely ask whether the resulting behavior is human-like. Here, we bridge this gap by transforming psychological tasks into dynamic environments in which agents can interact and by using a learned human-policy model to evaluate how compatible the resulting behavioral trajectories are with human behavior. Across these environments, we find that this compatibility varies with an LLM's agentic configuration and the psychological task, and that memory raises it mainly by making choices more predictable rather than more human-like. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation of LLM agents in psychology-inspired environments, accounting for both the backbone model and its agentic scaffold.

papers.title_en: COGENT: A Modular Cognitive Architecture for Agentic User Simulation
papers.authors: Yikun Chi, Adam Davies, Debarati Das, Lin Ai, Scott Counts
papers.evidence: 用LLM智能体模拟用户在界面中的感知、推理与行动。
papers.tldr: 常规计算机操作智能体追求任务完成，却难以复现用户如何感知界面、形成判断并选择操作。COGENT借鉴认知理论，将感知、记忆、用户状态、意图和动作选择拆为显式模块，并用六项演示追踪单点修改如何改变行为。评测显示，它比基线更能复现人类操作记录，差异具有统计显著性，也重现了人类自报心理状态之间的关系结构。这为界面设计和无障碍研究提供了可解释、可干预的用户模拟工具。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based user simulation can support interface design, accessibility research, and interactive-agent evaluation, but standard computer-use agents are optimized for task completion rather than reproducing how people perceive, reason, and act. We introduce COGENT (COGnitive agENT), a modular cognitive architecture for simulating user interaction with desktop interfaces. COGENT draws on established cognitive theories, such as Norman's action cycle and ACT-R, to enable explainable, intervenable, and modular user simulation by decomposing the simulation process into cognitive modules with explicit representations of perception, memory, user state, intentions, and action selection. We begin by presenting six intervenability demonstrations, each tracing how a single edit to memory, a user attribute, or a processing module propagates through the cognitive pipeline to produce a behavioral change. We evaluate COGENT's behavioral and attributional fidelity across three benchmarks -- AgentNetBench, A11y-CUA, and SENSE-42 -- finding that it achieves statistically significant fidelity gains over computer-use baselines in reproducing recorded human behavior and recovers the relational structure among human self-reported psychological states. Together, these demos and evaluations demonstrate COGENT's utility toward more faithful, explainable, intervenable, and modular LLM-based cognitive simulations.

papers.title_en: SecondChance: Benchmarking Reliable Error Recovery in AI Agents
papers.authors: Atahan Dokme, Adar Avsian, Larry Heck
papers.evidence: 评估智能体出错后的修复行为及用户提示作用
papers.tldr: 智能体最终完成任务，不代表它消除了先前操作留下的错误，故障注入也难以模拟这类没有报错的失误。SecondChance 从三个工具使用基准提取智能体实际犯错后的检查点，让不同模型在四种提示条件下从相同状态继续执行。对十二个模型的评估显示，表现最好的模型在无提示时仅有 16% 实现完整恢复，获得修复指导后也只有 27%。该基准将错误纠正、任务完成和状态保全分开衡量，揭示了单看任务成功率会漏掉的残留错误。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents make errors while they act, and their reliability depends on what they do afterwards. Existing recovery benchmarks mostly inject faults, involve no user and score whether the task is eventually completed, so they cannot show whether an agent undid its own silent error, told the user, or faced an error that could not be fixed. We introduce SecondChance, an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that profiles and measures error-recovery behaviour of AI agents. The errors are natural: they come from agents' own task attempts in $τ^2$-bench, BFCL and AppWorld. Different agents then resume from the same checkpoints under one of four conditions: no assistance, an error notice, the error location, or repair guidance. We measure error correction, task success, policy compliance, preservation of environment state, repair durability and cost. We evaluate 12 models under all four conditions in 5,760 continuations. Recovery is rare: across its environments, the best model completes only 16% of recoveries unaided and 27% with repair guidance. Correcting is not recovering: with repair guidance, Llama-3.3-70B corrects 26% of $τ^2$ errors but completes none, and 40 of 84 successful AppWorld continuations leave the error in place. SecondChance exposes these differences that task success alone cannot capture.

papers.title_en: E2SIM: Long-Horizon Simulation of Everyday Human Behavior with Evolving States
papers.authors: Ziwei Gong, Xiangyang Yin, Thai Quoc On, Lin Ai, Julia Hirschberg, Haotong Yang
papers.evidence: 对长期演变的人类角色状态及共享环境进行联合模拟
papers.tldr: 长期用户模拟不仅要保持人物设定一致，还要让工作与生活中的行动后果持续影响用户的目标、认知和行为。E2SIM联合建模持续变化的角色状态与共享环境，通过即时行动、延迟结果和角色各自的观察形成反馈闭环。一次六十天模拟中，相较于四种直接生成基线，E2SIM提取出的事件线索中，被评估器判为有意义的更多，近重复动作更少。论文还提出一组轨迹诊断指标，用于评估动态一致性、事件推进、协作和轨迹是否陷入重复。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly expected to support users over long periods, across work, and daily life. This requires modeling not only who users are, but also how their goals, interests, activities, and interactions evolve over time. A challenge in longitudinal user simulation is maintaining consistency between these evolving states and the consequences of actions in a shared environment. We introduce E2SIM, a longitudinal user simulation framework that jointly models evolving actor states and a dynamic shared environment. E2SIM connects actor-state updates with shared-world changes through a feedback loop linking immediate actions, delayed outcomes, and actor-specific observations across work and life. This allows the consequences of earlier actions to shape later behavior, while preserving differences in what each actor knows. We further propose a suite of longitudinal trajectory diagnostics, measuring dynamic consistency, coherent event progression and collaboration, and non-degenerate trajectory development rather than static consistency alone. In one 60-day simulation, E2SIM produced more extracted event threads judged meaningful by our evaluator and fewer near-duplicate actions than four direct-generation baselines. The framework and evaluation methods provide a basis for studying longitudinal user simulation, with potential applications in training and evaluating AI agents that assist users over extended periods.

papers.title_en: Modeling Event-Conditioned Emotional Expression Response with LLM Agents in a Synthetic Social Simulation
papers.authors: Rebecca Marigliano, Peter Carragher, Kathleen M. Carley
papers.evidence: 在合成社会模拟中用LLM智能体建模情绪反应与集体行为。
papers.tldr: 多数行为模型难以刻画情绪如何影响决策与集体行动，而大语言模型代理能否复现人群的情绪表达也缺少实证检验。研究用分层提示为代理注入人口特征、心理特征和事件情境，并以大规模 Facebook 反应数据及人口和人格基准进行验证。模拟较好地复现了群体情绪的两极分化与趋同模式，但代理表达愤怒的程度低于人类基线。该框架为行为模拟纳入情绪提供了可验证的方法，也表明代理在代表真实人群前仍需校准。
papers.abstract_en: Emotions are central drivers of human behavior, yet most behavioral models fail to capture their role in shaping perception, decision-making, and collective action. Application areas such as emergency response and public health are especially constrained by the lack of emotion-aware modeling. While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into agent-based models (ABMs), little work has examined how to endow LLM agents with emotional reasoning or validated their ability to reproduce empirically observed emotional patterns. This study addresses this gap by introducing a hierarchical prompting framework that conditions LLM agents with demographic, psychological, and contextual cues to generate event-conditioned emotional responses to real-world events. We validate the resulting event-conditioned emotional responses against large-scale social media reaction data derived from the Social Science One Facebook URL Shares Dataset, complemented by demographic and personality benchmarks. Our simulation results reproduce both polarized and consensus-driven emotional patterns with significant fidelity, supporting the application of LLM agents for emotion-aware modeling in behavioral simulations. We also find, however, that systematic gaps in emotional expression of LLM agents and human populations exist, such as the underexpression of anger relative to human baselines. As such, these findings highlight the need for continued calibration if LLM agents are to serve as proxies for human populations in behavioral modeling. By quantifying their divergence from human populations in terms of emotional expression, we hope that our methods can aid in this effort.

papers.title_en: Privacy Disclosure Control Benchmark (PDC-Bench): How Faithfully Do LLMs Keep Privacy Constraints on In-Context Disclosure Granularity?
papers.authors: Kosuke Fujita, Daiki Nishiyama, Jun Sakuma
papers.evidence: 评估模型是否遵守用户设定的个人信息披露粒度限制
papers.tldr: 大模型根据含有个人信息的上下文执行任务时，即使不复述原始属性，也可能因输出过于具体而泄露隐私，例如仅允许披露国家却给出了州名。论文用知识图谱的层级定义允许披露的最细粒度，并构建涵盖地理、年龄、种族与族裔、职业的16105条样本。对11个模型的评测显示，语义泄露占违规事件的62%。这表明隐私审计不能只匹配原始值，还应按允许的披露粒度和任务对私密属性的需求检查输出。
papers.abstract_en: In LLM task execution, a constraint on the permitted disclosure granularity of personal attributes is sometimes imposed on the output. For example, if a person's private attribute is their location (San Francisco) and disclosure is permitted only at the country level, an output at the state level (California) violates the constraint. Detecting such violations requires capturing not only direct privacy leakage (San Francisco) but also semantic leakage (California). However, existing benchmarks cannot measure the degree of leakage with respect to a given semantic constraint such as the country-level limit. We therefore formalize disclosure control as a constraint on the permitted ceiling over the hierarchy of a knowledge graph. Building on this formulation, we construct PDC-Bench, a benchmark of 16,105 samples covering geography, age, race and ethnicity, and occupation. In our experiments applying PDC-Bench to eleven LLMs, 62% of the constraint violations were semantic leakage. We further found that semantic leakage depends less on the model than on the permitted disclosure granularity and the task's need for the private attribute; reliable auditing must therefore target semantic leakage together with these two factors. Data, prompts, and code are available at https://github.com/fuji1655/PDC-Bench.

papers.title_en: ROSWORLD: When Digital Task Competence Meets Physical Execution
papers.authors: Caoyuan Ma, Wendi Liu, Zhimin Zhang, Muyao Niu, Yujie Lu, Zengxi Zhang, Ji Zhao, Shuai Dong, Wenpu Liu, Ziyue Wang, Wenzheng Chang, Taiqiang Wu, Weichu Xie, Yuqi Xu, Haiyuan Wan, Xuehui Wang, Jiaqi Wang, Wenqi Shao, Yinqiang Zheng
papers.evidence: 评测操作电脑的智能体使用实体外设，揭示桌面能力迁移至物理操作时的落差
papers.tldr: 桌面智能体能直接发送键鼠指令，而机器人即使知道该点哪里，也必须通过精确接触完成输入。ROSWorld 将物理仿真工作站接入实时 OSWorld 桌面，让模型仅凭相机画面用单臂探针或双臂灵巧手操作，并沿用同一官方评测。五个模型在十款应用的四十项任务中，直接操作完成三十一至三十九项，探针和灵巧手最多分别完成二十三项和二十八项。轨迹对比发现，模型更依赖键盘，但仍常漏按、按错或误触，使桌面任务能力与物理执行之间的差距可以量化。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents now solve most desktop tasks through direct software input, but a robot using the same computer must turn GUI knowledge into physical contact with a keyboard and mouse. We introduce ROSWorld, a benchmark that couples a physically simulated robot workstation to a live OSWorld desktop, so that a robot and a desktop agent pursue the same goals under the same official evaluators. The evaluated model receives observations only from the workstation camera views and operates the peripherals through either a single-arm rigid probe or dual-arm dexterous hands. Across five frontier models and 40 tasks in ten applications, models that complete 31-39 tasks on the desktop complete at most 23 with the probe and 28 with the hands. Paired trajectory analysis shows that models adapt their interaction strategies toward keyboard input, yet physical execution frequently fails through missed presses, incorrect targets, and unintended contacts. ROSWorld makes the gap between knowing what to do on a computer and physically doing it measurable.

papers.title_en: Learning Inside Types: Epistemic Typestates for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Lorenzo Bacchiani, Mario Bravetti, Giovanni Pau, Roberto Girau
papers.evidence: 为多智能体强化学习提供按类型约束动作的安全机制
papers.tldr: 在部分可观测的多智能体强化学习中，探索动作是否安全取决于智能体看不见的环境状态及队友的选择。论文提出认知类型状态：各智能体只凭自身观测和动作更新可能世界集合，仅执行在所有这些世界中、面对队友任一合规动作都安全的动作。九项基准均未出现违规，任务表现与两种屏蔽方法无显著差异，十智能体实例的类型合成耗时不到一秒。该方法允许逐个检查智能体，并为无需通信且遵守类型的任意策略提供团队安全保证。
papers.abstract_en: Type disciplines make programs safe by construction: components checked against each other's types compose into programs that cannot go wrong in the ways the types exclude. Types suit reinforcement learning: a type constrains what an agent may choose, not how it chooses, so the guarantee holds for every policy a learner produces. We introduce epistemic typestates, a type discipline for safe multi-agent reinforcement learning. An agent's type is a protocol whose states record its beliefs, the worlds it cannot rule out from its own observations and actions, and permits only actions that are safe in every world of the belief, whatever the others do within their public types. Agents learn inside their types, which are built and checked one agent at a time and run without communication. We prove type soundness and team safety, give a synthesis that is sound and complete, build types from guards when worlds are infinite, and show that shields are a special case. All proofs are mechanised in Rocq. On nine benchmarks, no typed learner causes a safety violation, and task performance does not differ significantly from that of two recent multi-agent shielding methods. Where a contract-based method fails at five and ten agents, types for ten agents are built in under a second. In the two continuous benchmarks, Lagrangian learners cause thousands of violations in every training run.

papers.title_en: Motoric signatures to detect original authorship versus cognitive effort in instructed motor responses of an emerging speaker with ASD
papers.authors: Elizabeth B. Torres
papers.evidence: 将辅助打字视为沟通系统，并通过动作特征考察作者性与能动性
papers.tldr: 辅助打字中的按键动作并不能说明内容由谁构思，而认知努力也可能影响动作表现。研究对一名自闭症谱系参与者开展个案实验，在独立和辅助打字条件下，比较其开放作答与按指令输入相同短语时的动作。头面部微动作的统计特征和三维轨迹均能区分两类任务，且只有开放作答出现前导动作。结果为区分自主构思与执行指令时的认知努力提供了个体化线索，但尚不能据此独立判定消息归属。
papers.abstract_en: There is at present no objective, agnostic method to track levels of message authorship and agency in non-speakers who rely on assisted typing to communicate. Part of the problem is that nuances in spontaneous gestural movements of the typer transpire largely beneath awareness of both the typer and the communication-regulation-partner. Such spontaneous movements co-occur with the intentional ones producing the typed messages but are currently not considered part of the communication system. We introduce an assay that probes various levels of cognitive loads in an ecologically valid environment. Then, in collaboration with an emerging speaker-typer and his communication-regulation-partner, we empirically estimate motoric stochastic signatures during both independent and assisted typing. Under varying levels of cognitive loads, the assay and biometrics distinguish motoric patterns in spontaneous typing of phrases in response to open-ended questions from those in instructed typing of the same phrase. The non-dominant bodily motions, co-occurring with the dominant (typing) side reveal not only levels of cognitive mental effort and agency of the typer but also levels of creative thoughts through motoric preambles present only in open-ended mode. This level of semantic authorship is detectable in both the geodesic paths along the manifold representing the Gamma stochastic parameters of the motions fluctuations and those of the physical 3D spatial trajectories. The head and facial micro-motions capture these non-dominant-body nuances, offering a personalized motoric metric of cognitive effort, agency, authorship and a comprehensive suite of assays to open new research avenues for assisted typing with haptic support.

papers.title_en: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
papers.authors: Aniruddh Pramod, Matthew Khoriaty, James Lucassen, Adam Kaufman
papers.evidence: 通过询问智能体解释行动来增强人工监督与控制。
papers.tldr: 当智能体的能力超过可信监控模型时，后者可能看不懂其操作，或无法可靠判断操作是否安全。论文让监控模型针对可疑操作提问，并评估智能体的解释能否消除疑点。在 BashArena 留出子集上，审计预算为 1% 时，安全性从仅查看操作的 72.6% 升至 79.5%。但只让可信模型明确指出具体疑点，就能获得大部分增益；这提示应区分提出疑点与听取解释各自的作用。
papers.abstract_en: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.

papers.title_en: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
papers.authors: Yitong Qiao, Lei Liu, Yue Shen, Jian Wang, Jinjie Gu, Zhixuan Chu
papers.evidence: 交互式图形界面智能体环境评测基于屏幕的感知与操作
papers.tldr: 临床工作常需在电子健康记录界面中查阅病历并完成精确操作，但现有医疗智能体多依赖文本或结构化工具调用。MedUIGym 整合十七个基准来源的一万五千余项任务，在相同临床数据上提供截图键鼠与原生工具两种接口，同时核验最终答案和必需操作。十二个模型普遍表现吃力，增加推理投入并未带来稳定收益；训练后的两个 Qwen3.5 模型在域内任务上均有提升，并能泛化到外部来源任务。该平台将临床界面评测、轨迹采集与训练整合到同一环境中。
papers.abstract_en: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.

papers.title_en: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience
papers.authors: Yuzhou Chen, Licheng Pan, Zhixuan Chu, Yunsheng Lu, Yichen Sun, Han Zheng, Yan Wang, Bingyu Zhu, Haiwen Hong, Longtao Huang, Kui Ren
papers.evidence: 处理受污染经验影响长期LLM智能体后续行为的风险。
papers.tldr: 长程大语言模型智能体会将历史执行轨迹提炼成可复用经验，但其中的误导或对抗指令可能跨任务留存，影响后续行动。ExpGuard 在检索时结合当前任务、经验来源和执行依赖构建异构图，并通过配对反事实回放学习区分攻击成功风险与正常任务失败风险。实验表明，该框架能够识别高风险经验，并减轻经验污染对智能体的影响。它在经验进入智能体上下文前完成风险评估，并对高风险经验在线修复、重新评分。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents distill past trajectories into reusable experiences. Misleading or adversarial guidance in source trajectories can corrupt these experiences, allowing harmful instructions to persist across tasks and influence future agent actions. Assessing the risks of potentially corrupted experiences poses three challenges: (1) modeling provenance and execution dependencies before experience reuse, (2) learning task-conditioned risk from trajectory outcomes, and (3) repairing risky experiences at online inference. To address these challenges, we present ExpGuard, a framework for retrieval-triggered experience risk assessment and online repair. Specifically, to tackle challenge (1), ExpGuard integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph to predict attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse. To enable task-conditioned risk supervision and tackle challenge (2), we conduct matched counterfactual replays of each original experience and its minimally neutralized counterpart from the same task and environment checkpoint, deriving separate risk labels from differences in attack success and legitimate task completion. To tackle challenge (3) at inference time, ExpGuard repairs candidate experiences flagged as high-risk by the graph-based predictor at retrieval and re-predicts their risks before they enter the agent's active experience context. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpGuard in identifying risky experiences and defending agents against experience corruption.

papers.title_en: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
papers.authors: Qingle Liu, Jieming Li, Pei-lin Li, Shenghan Zheng, Ruize Yang, Sunqi Fan, Deyao Hong, Huan-ang Gao, Meng-Hao Guo, Shuojin Yang
papers.evidence: 通过计算机和机器人界面评测智能体适应用户特定规则的能力。
papers.tldr: 现有上下文学习评测多依赖离线文本或静态图像，难以衡量智能体能否在实际交互中学会并执行新规则。ICLWorld 通过统一接口覆盖电脑与机器人操作，在30个环境中为160项任务各设三套规则，用文本或视频提供规则，并测试从复现演示到跨环境迁移的能力。表现最好的两款模型在电脑端成功率为82%和76%，在机器人端仅为27%和26%。规则问答与任务执行的对照进一步表明，能说清规则并不等于能按规则行动。
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time. The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations. We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface. We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context. Each task comes with three rule versions, given as text or video, and we test generalization at three levels, from replaying the demonstration to new instances and unseen environments. Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%. GPT-6 Astra succeeds under all three rule versions on only 38% of computer-use tasks, half its rate under a single rule, and answers 98% of robot rule questions correctly yet completes only 20% of these tasks. Frontier agents learn rules comparably well from video and from text and transfer them across environments, whereas weaker agents rely on text and lose most of their video-based success once the demonstrated situation is resampled. These findings reveal substantial gaps between the digital and the physical world and between identifying a rule and acting on it.

papers.title_en: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
papers.authors: Weihao Cheng
papers.evidence: 利用智能体游玩经验改进游戏设计，以提升玩家参与感
papers.tldr: 人工智能代理已能生成可玩的游戏，但让玩家通过练习逐步掌握技巧，仍依赖大量人工试玩与调校。PlayCraft 交替执行试玩与改版：视觉代理保留跨局记忆并记录决策与结果，设计代理据此预测不同熟练度的表现，对照目标学习曲线调整游戏。在三种智能水平的独立评估中，多数游戏的学习增益更大、学习斜率更陡，两项指标的宏平均均优于基线。结果表明，代理的试玩经验可用于自动改进游戏，为更好的决策和操作创造有意义的回报。
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.

papers.title_en: Co-Evolving Behavioral Agents and Detectors for Adaptive Information Operations
papers.authors: Lin Tian, Marian-Andrei Rizoiu
papers.evidence: 以模拟行为智能体研究信息行动传播行为及其对检测的影响。
papers.tldr: 仅用已下架行动训练的检测器，面对未见过的行动方时表现明显下滑，也难以应对会主动改变行为的账号。IO-AI让模拟账号与检测器交替训练，再按检测难度由低到高训练最终检测器。在20场Twitter信息行动的实验中，相近误报率下，自适应账号的漏检相对减少65%，对未见行动方的F1从0.62升至0.81。研究还发现，账号群体的行为差异越大，检测器越难迁移，可据此安排新群体的测试优先级。
papers.abstract_en: Detectors of state-sponsored information operations (IOs) are trained on campaigns that platforms have already taken down. They lose much of their accuracy on an actor they have not seen, even though no operator in the archived data is trying to avoid them. A real operator wants two things, to reach an audience and to avoid being caught. We present IO-AI, a framework that gives simulated agents these two capabilities, engagement and evasion, and tests what each one does to detection. The agents are built from the posting behavior of real campaigns and choose the emotion, type, and timing of each post. An agent and a detector then train against each other in turn. We rank the trained agents by how hard they are to detect and train one detector on them from easiest to hardest. On 20 Twitter IO campaigns, this detector reduces missed detections of adaptive agents by 65% relative to a detector trained only on the archived campaigns, at a similar false-alarm rate. On actors it has never seen it reaches an F1 of 0.81, against 0.62. We find that an agent trained to seek engagement becomes easier to catch, because it learns the fast, emotional retweeting that archived campaigns were caught producing. An agent that was trained for engagement before the game keeps its engagement lead after it learns to evade. We also introduce a behavioral distance metric that compares two groups of accounts using only their unlabeled posting histories. The larger the distance between two groups, the worse a detector trained on one does on the other (Spearman rho = -0.58), so the metric can be used to choose which new groups to test first.

papers.title_en: From Manufacturing Event Logs to Simulation: Enabling SMEs with Agentic AI for SimPy Simulation Generation
papers.authors: Richard Reider, Lina Döring, Sebastian Lang, Tobias Reggelin, Sebastian Trojahn, Pascal Reusch
papers.evidence: 结合智能体人工智能与人在环验证生成制造仿真模型
papers.tldr: 离散事件仿真的专业门槛与成本限制了中小制造企业的应用。GenAI4SimPy 以本地开放权重模型 Qwen 3.6（27B）驱动多智能体，结合工具推理与人工验证，将制造事件日志转为可执行的 SimPy 模型。公开数据的三个运行区块中，平均绝对百分比误差为 7.9%，故障率覆盖全部区块，吞吐量覆盖其中两个。研究表明，本地模型可达到与云端方案相当的精度，但工序参数提取准确并不等于系统行为可信，仍需正确处理观测窗口截断并开展系统级校准。
papers.abstract_en: High expertise and cost barriers exclude small and medium-sized enterprises from discrete-event simulation (DES). We introduce GenAI4SimPy, a multi-agent framework powered by Qwen 3.6 (27B), an open-weight large language model, that automates end-to-end DES generation from manufacturing event logs to executable SimPy models through tool-augmented reasoning and human-in-the-loop validation. Evaluated on three execution blocks from a public smart factory dataset, the framework achieved a mean absolute percentage error of 7.9\% and coverage of failure rate for all three blocks and of throughput for two of three. A fidelity paradox was observed: accurate process-level parameters did not ensure system-level behavioral fidelity, with flow-time and throughput errors driven by misinterpreted observation-window truncation and absent system-level calibration. These results demonstrate that local open-weight models can perform DES generation at accuracy comparable to cloud-based alternatives, while identifying parameter extraction as necessary but insufficient for behavioral validity. Source code and results are available at https://github.com/RaikoPipe/genai4simpy

papers.title_en: Benchmarking EEG feature families for ADHD research in children and adolescents: performance and explainability across attention tasks
papers.authors: Javier Sanchis, Jorge García-Carrasco, Álvaro Navarro, Tahar Kechadi, Juan Trujillo
papers.evidence: 评估用于辅助ADHD临床表征的脑电特征。
papers.tldr: 儿童青少年注意缺陷多动障碍的脑电研究采用不同特征与评估方法，结果难以横向比较。研究在两款游戏产生的四个重叠注意任务队列中，以重复嵌套的参与者留出评估比较七类脑电特征和四种组合。表现最佳的任务中，最高平均AUROC为0.773，连接性特征较频谱特征平均高0.208，F4–AF4电极间的β频段相干性多次居归因首位。结果为独立复现提供了候选特征，但不足以支持通用特征推荐或临床诊断。
papers.abstract_en: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder varies in presentation. Diagnosis requires clinical and developmental assessment. Reproducible electroencephalography measures may complement clinical and behavioural characterisation, but differing feature definitions and evaluation methods hinder comparison. We compared seven feature families and four combinations across attention tasks and assessed the stability of held-out explanations. Two serious games yielded four overlapping attention-task cohorts of 123-140 participants each. Repeated nested participant-held-out evaluation assessed recruitment-group discrimination. Exploratory paired participant-cluster bootstrap tests corrected for multiplicity in two separate families: 72 individual-task contrasts and 18 fusion contrasts. For eight configurations selected after inspecting predictive results, we explained held-out native probabilities before calibration. In the strongest task context, the highest configuration mean AUROC over three repetitions was 0.773, with a fixed-prediction 95% interval of 0.692-0.854 unadjusted for selecting the maximum. Precision, sensitivity and specificity were 0.740, 0.556 and 0.861. In that task, the paired AUROC difference for connectivity minus spectral features averaged +0.2083 across six classifiers and the common 8 s and 16 s durations, with pointwise 95% CI 0.1076-0.3072 and adjusted p = 0.0036. F4-AF4 beta-band coherence led repetition-level attribution summaries in five selected procedures and was selected in every fit. Other contexts showed weaker discrimination and less consistent retention of leading scientific inputs. No general classifier winner emerged. Connectivity and its recurring coherence input warrant independent replication, but do not justify a universal feature recommendation. These exploratory findings do not establish causal task effects, disease mechanisms or diagnostic validity.

papers.title_en: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
papers.authors: Siyu Zhou, Jing Jiang, Chengqi Zhang, Guodong Long
papers.evidence: 研究视觉智能体如何从交互历史与新任务中学习
papers.tldr: 视觉智能体的动作会改变后续观测，论文考察蒸馏所需的交互经验能否压缩到少量任务或轨迹。研究按技能与情境的覆盖度及视觉决策序列的相似性筛选轨迹，再通过实时交互或固定历史上的新学生响应进行在策略蒸馏。仅用四条轨迹，4B学生在标准导航和推箱子上分别提升约33和25个百分点，均弥合了与27B教师超过九成的性能差距。独立导航评测中，回放无需新增环境交互，仍保留同任务在线训练九成以上的增益。
papers.abstract_en: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.

papers.title_en: DataRecycle: Trustworthy Distillation of Structured Data from Scattered Web Evidence
papers.authors: Can Liu, Tengteng Zhu, Xinyu Jiang, Xiaolin Wen, Yong Wang
papers.evidence: 交互系统协助用户核验并整理分散的网络证据
papers.tldr: 网页上的数值证据分散在不同文档中，数据稀疏、统计口径不一，甚至相互矛盾；搜索结果需要人工整理，生成式摘要又可能掩盖出处和分歧。DataRecycle 将用户查询拆为实体和属性，由本体引导检索，把数值与原文片段关联，并按时间、定义和尺度对齐记录。模块实验、使用案例和用户研究表明，系统能帮助用户把零散证据整理成可追溯的表格，让用户在比较数值时也能核查出处、识别不确定性和来源冲突。
papers.abstract_en: The web contains vast amounts of scattered quantitative evidence that is difficult to organize into comparable and verifiable structures. Yet its unstructured, sparse, and sometimes conflicting nature makes a systematic distillation costly and error-prone. Existing approaches force users to make a trade-off: search engines return document lists that require labor-intensive extraction and reconciliation, while generative AI systems produce fluent summaries that obscure data provenance, introduce reporting bias, and hide inconsistencies. We present DataRecycle, an interactive system that helps transform scattered web evidence into structured tables of comparable numerical facts. Given a user's query or statement, DataRecycle decomposes it into entities and attributes, retrieves candidate evidence, and organizes scattered, potentially conflicting records in a table-based evidence view. To address key challenges in automated data distillation (i.e., incomplete retrieval, untraceable generation, sparse data distribution, and multi-source inconsistency), DataRecycle adopts an ontology-guided, top-down data acquisition strategy, visualizes the recorded lineage from retrieved snippets to extracted values, and aligns heterogeneous data across dimensions such as time, definition, and scale. We evaluate DataRecycle through module-level experiments, a usage scenario, and a user study, showing that the system helps users organize numerical web evidence into provenance-linked tables and inspect uncertainty and conflicting sources.
